# waroom_on_call_escalation_policy (Resource)

Manages a Waroom on-call escalation policy. An escalation policy defines which on-call teams are called, in which order, and on which days and times.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "waroom_on_call_team" "sre" {
  name = "SRE"
}

data "waroom_on_call_team" "backend" {
  name = "Backend"
}

# Call up to two people in the SRE team first, then everyone in the Backend team at once,
# on weekdays during business hours.
resource "waroom_on_call_escalation_policy" "example" {
  name           = "Primary escalation"
  timezone       = "Asia/Tokyo"
  call_depth     = 2
  call_traversal = "depth_first"

  steps = [
    {
      team_uuid = data.waroom_on_call_team.sre.uuid
    },
    {
      team_uuid         = data.waroom_on_call_team.backend.uuid
      step_type         = "fallback"
      simultaneous_call = true
    },
  ]

  time_slots = [
    for day in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] : {
      day_of_week = day
      start_time  = "09:00"
      end_time    = "18:00"
    }
  ]
}

# A slot whose end_time is earlier than its start_time continues into the next day.
resource "waroom_on_call_escalation_policy" "night" {
  name = "Night shift"

  steps = [
    { team_uuid = data.waroom_on_call_team.sre.uuid },
  ]

  time_slots = [
    { day_of_week = 5, start_time = "22:00", end_time = "06:00" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the escalation policy.
- `time_slots` (Attributes Set) The days of the week and times when the escalation policy is active. At least one is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_slots))

### Optional

- `call_depth` (Number) How many people, counted from the on-duty user in the rotation order, are called in each step's team (1 to 10). Absent users are not counted; users who cannot be called (e.g. without a phone number) are counted. Omit it to call everyone in the team.
- `call_traversal` (String) The order in which steps and people are called. `depth_first` calls up to `call_depth` people in a step before moving on to the next step; `breadth_first` calls the on-duty user of every step first, then the second person of every step, and so on. Defaults to `depth_first`.
- `steps` (Attributes List) The escalation steps, in escalation order. Defaults to no steps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))
- `timezone` (String) The timezone (IANA format, e.g. `Asia/Tokyo`) that `time_slots` are interpreted in. Defaults to `Asia/Tokyo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Escalation policy ID. This is an alias for `uuid`.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the escalation policy. This is automatically generated by Waroom.

<a id="nestedatt--time_slots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_slots`

Required:

- `day_of_week` (Number) The day of the week (0 is Sunday, 6 is Saturday).
- `end_time` (String) The end time (`HH:MM`) in the policy's `timezone`. If it is earlier than `start_time`, the slot continues into the next day. `23:59` includes the end of the day.
- `start_time` (String) The start time (`HH:MM`) in the policy's `timezone`.


<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `team_uuid` (String) The UUID of the on-call team called in this step.

Optional:

- `simultaneous_call` (Boolean) Whether all participants of the team's active rotation are called at the same time in this step. Defaults to `false`.
- `step_type` (String) The type of the step: `primary` or `fallback`. Defaults to `primary`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# On-call escalation policies can be imported by specifying the escalation policy UUID
import {
  to = waroom_on_call_escalation_policy.example
  id = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# On-call escalation policies can be imported by specifying the escalation policy UUID
terraform import waroom_on_call_escalation_policy.example 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
